name: Frank O'Donald
role: Hunter; companion and claimed partner of Luffsey
bio: Frank O'Donald (also spelled O'Donnell) was a hunter and companion of Luffsey, who was killed in 1883 by a party that included the Marquis de Mores. In 1885 the paper recounted his drunken threat in 1883 to shoot the Marquis over his fencing, and at the Marquis's September 1885 trial witnesses testified that O'Donald and Luffsey had threatened the Marquis and had bad reputations; in January 1886 O'Donald claimed a share of Luffsey's estate as his partner.
